feeds.title: The Whiskey Wash » Irish
feeds.description: Covering great Irish whiskies one bottle at a time in this segment of the blog. We started writing about the whiskey lifestyle back in late 2013. We love discovering new whiskeys, sharing drams with friends, collecting hard-to-find bottles, and diving into the science and history behind our favorite tipples.

feeds.title: Irish Whiskey Magazine
feeds.description: Immerse yourself in the exciting world of Irish whiskey with Irish Whiskey Magazine, the authoritative magazine for insights and developments. The aim is to produce a world-leading publication with in-depth and approachable articles laid out in a beautifully designed and tactile quarterly magazine. Irish Whiskey Magazine has gone from being a mere idea to becoming a valuable print reference point for all things related to the Irish whiskey world.

feeds.title: The Whiskey Reviewer » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: The Whiskey Reviewer talks about the famous Irish Whiskey and reviews them here. The Whiskey Reviewer is a web magazine covering the world of whisk(e)y. We have been cited, quoted, and reprinted by the American Distilling Institute, The Atlantic, BroBible, Cheat Sheet, Drinkhacker, Eater, Foodista, Islay Daily News, and more.

feeds.title: Drinkhacker » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Read reviews on Irish Whisky written by the experts at Drinkhacker. Welcome to Drinkhacker, the insider's guide to good drinking, which covers cocktails, spirits, wine, and beer. Drinkhacker was founded in 2007 by Christopher Null, a longtime entertainment, technology, and lifestyle writer, and award-winning winemaker.

feeds.title: Westmeath Whiskey World » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Explore the world of Irish Whiskey from Westmeath. A hopefully humorous, informative, and enjoyable blog from, but not necessarily about Westmeath. Usually themed around whiskey, although other beverages may feature.

feeds.title: Whiskey Blogger » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: The Irish Whiskey Blog is the Home Page of Whiskey Blogger for Irish Whiskey Reviews and the Latest News from the Very Best Irish Whiskey Brands. Award-Winning International Whiskey Blogger Stuart McNamara Blogs about Whisky and Whiskey.

feeds.title: The Pot Still Whiskey Blog
feeds.description: The Pot Still, your source for tasting notes, reviews, and ratings of Irish, Bourbons, Scotches, and Whiskeys of the world. The Pot Still was created to follow the explosion of energy, innovation, and to track the rise of the new whiskey lifestyle, especially the Revival of the Irish Whiskey Industry.

feeds.title: Stories & Sips Whiskey Club
feeds.description: Know more about New Irish whiskey releases, the latest Irish whiskey distillery news and updates on the growth and progress of our Irish Whiskey Club. Stories & Sips helps fans and potential fans of Irish whiskey across the United States connect deeply with Ireland and its famous brown spirit through in-person and virtual experiences, storytelling and tastings.

feeds.title: Irish Whiskey USA
feeds.description: Irish Whiskey Society America is a whiskey club celebrating Irish Whiskey in the USA. We strive to enhance the Irish whiskey experience for our club members with events, bottlings, trips, news, stories and more! We are a community of Irish Whiskey lovers.

feeds.title: Irishmalts Blog
feeds.description: Get all the latest news on Irish Whiskey. Established in 2018, Irishmalts is the leading global retailer of the finest craft whiskey's, gins and vodkas that the Emerald Isle has to offer. Irishmalts was founded by two whiskey loving brothers from County Cork when they noticed that many Irish Whiskey and Spirits producers were struggling to make their products internationally accessible.

feeds.title: Dave's Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: David O Connell is my name and I live in Dublin, Ireland. Here I share part of whiskey events in Ireland.

feeds.title: Malt » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: The following section of Malt features articles covering Irish whisky. Malt is a whisky and spirits blog, committed to critical evaluation within a price-sensitive scoring framework. We are guided by the principles of Independence, Diversity, and Humility.

feeds.title: The Whiskyphiles » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Read about Irish Whiskey in this segment of The Whiskyphiles. The Whiskyphiles started in 2013 as an online repository of whisky tasting notes. The Whiskyphiles has since become one of the most popular whisky blogs both within the UK where it is based and worldwide.

feeds.title: Whisky Queen » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Hello there, I'm Susanne, aka Whisky Queen. I share my tasting experiences and thoughts about Irish whisky and whiskey here. I have this nickname not because I'm a whisky connoisseur, but because I'm passionate about whisky and whiskey. Whisky Queen was launched in August 2020, as a fun project alongside my earlier whiskey blog, where I could allow myself to be an amateur and just have a bit of fun around whisky.

feeds.title: J.J. Corry Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: We Are Whiskey Bonders Maturing Whiskey on Our Family Farm in County Clare. We've started this blog to document this exciting journey and also if I'm really honest as a bit of start-up therapy.

feeds.title: Whisky Reviews » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Browse through Reviews of affordable Irish whisky with some entertaining tales along the way. Whisky Reviews is a site by Neil Murphy, a whisky enthusiast, writing about his love for whisky.

feeds.title: Whisky Flavour Blog » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Explore our articles on Irish Whisky, flavors, brands and more! Whisky Flavour was born from a Whisky Lover's desire to taste and know different kinds of whiskies, in the most convenient and affordable way possible.

feeds.title: Whiskey Island Blog
feeds.description: Stay up to date with our latest news and updates via our blog. Here we offer guides, tips, news, press releases and more! We do fully escorted Irish whiskey trails and we also do private whiskey tastings at (online) events! We're a father and son duo and we both have a wealth of experience between us, especially in the whiskey tourism domain.

feeds.title: The Cask Magazine
feeds.description: Learn everything you need to know about whisky in the magazine. Ireland's only magazine dedicated to Whiskey enthusiasts, connoisseurs and collectors.

feeds.title: Whiskey Apostle » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: The Best Irish Whiskey Reviews and Latest Irish Whiskey Brands News by Whiskey Apostle. Our goal is to proselytize the faith in the golden dream. Whether we're answering your questions, helping you find the perfect dream, or just introducing you to the wonderful world of whisky; we want to help you raise a dram and imbibe in the 'water of life.'

feeds.title: The Whiskey Jug » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: A section of the whiskey blog is dedicated to Irish whiskey reviews, whiskey cocktails, and commentary. The Whiskey Jug is your source to read reviews, whiskey cocktails, recipes, news, and info.

feeds.title: Whisky Of The Week » Irish Whiskey
feeds.description: Irish Whiskey Blog post related to Irish whiskey that I have tasted. I capture my review and tasting notes for each Irish whiskey. I am Jeannette, and this is my little spot on the internet. Here I combine my love of whisky, food, and experimenting. Here you can find tasting notes for over 300 whiskies. If you want to learn more about whisky or want to pair whisky with food, this is the place for you.

feeds.title: The Craft Irish Whiskey Co.
feeds.description: Your indispensable guide to barrel craft, cocktail recipes, how to taste whiskey and much more. Consider the Whiskey Guide your personal whiskey expert. From timeless tips to behind-the-scenes glimpses of our groundbreaking craft, it's a one-stop destination for all things cask, barrel and bond. From the World's Best Irish Single Malt to the world's most expensive whiskey; our mission to restore Irish whiskey to its rightful place as a global leader has reminded the world of the beauty, complexity and rich depth to be found in a glass of Celtic whiskey.

feeds.title: Waterford Whiskey Society Blog
feeds.description: Learn more about Irish whisky, brands and history with us. The Waterford Whiskey Society was set up in Waterford by a group of friends that are passionate about whiskey. Our goal is to enjoy, learn and have fun! We live at an exciting time in the revival of Irish whiskey and we are eager to continue learning about both Irish whiskey and whiskey from other countries too.
